newsitem.title: USA: Dow ends string of record highs at 8th.
newsitem.headline: Dow ends string of record highs at 8th.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average ended slightly lower Monday as profit taking snapped the market's eight-session run into the record books.
Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow ended down 1.12 points at 6,346.91, in a minor retreat from Friday's record close of 6,348.03.
In the broader market, declining issues led advances by a slim margin on moderate volume of 391 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
